# limen_resource_profile (Resource)

A Limen resource profile: the fixed half of a resource, which writers complete (ADR-0042 §5). Its spec has the `template` a writer can't change, the `settable` fields and their bounds, and the label rules.

Only people write profiles, so the provider must be logged in as a person with `limen:admin` (`limen login`), not as a bot. Limen refuses to delete a profile that resources still complete or that a policy writer still names.

A bot's login is refused for this kind (`OUTSIDE_GRANT`, rule `kind`). Every write is checked against the document's etag and owner, so Terraform never overwrites a change it hasn't seen, and never touches a document another channel (Git, the console) or another source owns. During plan the provider dry-runs the change (`plan_checks`) and shows who gains or loses access.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The fixed half of a resource. A bot completes only the settable fields.
resource "limen_resource_profile" "payments_postgres" {
  name = "payments-postgres"

  spec = {
    template = {
      postgres        = { iam_auth = true, region = "eu-west-1", tls_ca_file = "/etc/limen/rds-ca.pem" }
      worker_selector = { network = "payments-vpc" }
    }
    settable = {
      "postgres.endpoint" = {
        hosts = ["*.c9xk2p.eu-west-1.rds.amazonaws.com"]
        ports = [5432]
      }
      "postgres.default_database" = {}
    }
    labels = {
      fixed   = { team = "payments" }
      allowed = { env = ["dev", "staging"] }
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Unique per kind across the control plane, and immutable: changing it replaces the document. 1 to 128 characters of `a-z`, `0-9`, `.`, `_`, and `-`. A bot writer's names must match its grant's name patterns.
- `spec` (Dynamic) The profile's `spec`, in exactly the shape of the YAML spec: `template`, `settable`, and `labels`. Limen parses it strictly: unknown fields are refused. `null` attributes are left out.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free text shown in the console and the CLI.
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels that roles select on. Keys are lowercase `a-z`, `0-9`, `.`, `_`, `-`. For a resource from a profile, only the keys and values the profile allows; its fixed labels are in `effective_labels`.
- `namespace` (String) The owner's namespace, the permission scope. Defaults to the provider's `default_namespace`, else the bot's grant's namespace. Moving a document to another namespace needs a person with `limen:admin`.
- `source` (String) The owner's source. Defaults to the provider's `default_source`. Changing it transfers the document (for example after `terraform state mv` into another state); a writer may move documents only between its own sources.

### Read-Only

- `channel` (String) How the owner writes the document: always `api` for documents Terraform manages.
- `created_at` (String) When the document was created (RFC 3339).
- `effective_labels` (Map of String) What roles select on: `labels` plus, for a resource from a profile, the profile's fixed labels.
- `effective_spec_json` (String) What enforcement uses, as JSON: for a resource from a profile, the profile's template merged with `spec`; otherwise the same as `spec`. Use `jsondecode()` to read it.
- `etag` (String) Opaque; changes whenever the document or its owner changes. Every write sends it back, so Limen refuses to overwrite a change Terraform hasn't seen.
- `id` (String) The document's name.
- `policy_version` (Number) The policy version this revision first appeared in.
- `updated_at` (String) When this revision was written (RFC 3339).
- `updated_by` (String) Who wrote this revision: a person, or `bot:<name>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = limen_resource_profile.payments_postgres
  id = "payments-postgres"
}
```
